data.credibility: Management frequently drops or stops reporting on specific operational and R&D guidance topics after initial quarters, though they reliably deliver on core headline targets like revenue growth and maintain strong profitability metrics.

lines.line: Promised >27% EBITDA margin; delivered 29.2% for FY26, successfully achieving the target.
Promised >INR 27,000 crores orders; missed with actuals of INR 19,300 crores in Q3.
Aimed for 15%+ revenue growth; delivered 16.2% for FY26, meeting expectations.
Promised INR 57,000 crores total order inflow; dropped tracking without final actuals.
Targeted >INR 1,600 crores R&D investment; dropped from subsequent updates.
Targeted >INR 1,000 crores capex; dropped tracking after Q2 FY26.
Targeted 3% to 4% export turnover; dropped reporting in later quarters.
Targeted 5% export turnover in 2 to 3 years; currently on track.
Targeted R&D investments >INR 2,000 crores next year; currently on track.
Aim to cross 10% non-defense turnover; dropped after initial mention.
Aim for minimum INR 1,000 crores from data center business; dropped.
Target minimum 20% year-on-year R&D growth; dropped after Q3 FY26.
Retained >15% revenue growth for FY27; tracking at 25.8% so far, on track.
Promised >28% EBITDA for FY27; currently slipping at 26.6% across first two quarters.
Expecting >INR 55,000 crores order inflow for FY27; currently on track.
Targeted INR 2,200 crores R&D investment for FY27; currently on track.
Targeted >INR 1,200 crores capital investment for FY27; currently on track.
Targeted USD 300 million in export orders for FY27; status remains pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 14.4% and net profit at 23.6% over five years, supported by a TTM net profit of INR 6,401 cr.
EBITDA margin expanded from 22.8% in FY21 to 29.2% in FY26, showcasing strong operating leverage.
Extremely strong balance sheet with a near-zero debt-to-equity ratio, backed by a net worth of INR 26,259 cr.
bear: Working-capital days stretched significantly from 47 to 135 days over the last five years.
Operating cash flow was only 59% of reported profit over five years, revealing a notable profit-to-cash gap.
Revenue remains heavily concentrated in defense at 88.13%, with non-defense sales sitting low at 6.2%.
